title: VividGovTech asset manifest (ASSET.md front matter)
description: Front matter of the ASSET.md file at the root of every asset repo. The body must also contain the sections: What it shows, How to deploy, What's faked or hardcoded, Known gaps. The validator also rejects Salesforce org URLs and org IDs anywhere in the file.

id.description: Unique, kebab-case. Becomes catalog/<id>.md and the wikilink target [[<id>]].

vertical.description: e.g. courts, code-enforcement, permitting, licensing. Each links to verticals/<value>.

platform.description: e.g. salesforce, experience-cloud, mulesoft, esri, box.

patterns.description: Optional. Reusable patterns this asset demonstrates. Each links to patterns/<value>.

depends_on.description: Asset ids this asset needs. Use [] when there are none.

org_requirements.description: Licenses, features, or settings the target org needs. A string, or a list of strings. Use "none" when there are none.

sanitized.description: true only after a person has reviewed the repo for client names, credentials, and hardcoded IDs.

owner.description: GitHub handle of the person responsible, e.g. @jdoe.

last_verified.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the asset was last deployed and checked.
